summary: H World Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K to announce the appointment of Mr. Yanjun Sun as an independent director, effective July 28, 2026. The press release details Mr. Sun's extensive experience in private equity, capital markets, and M&A, with prior roles at TPG Capital, Goldman Sachs, and Jardine Matheson. No transaction, shareholder vote, or material corporate action is involved. This is a routine board appointment disclosure by a foreign private issuer, with no special situation implications. No deal terms are stated.
